label: Наконец
description: A 10-sentence usage card for наконец (finally, at last).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Relief at last. 'Наконец' marks the long-awaited arrival, modifying the verb 'пришёл'. Fronted here, it carries an emotional charge of relief, reinforced by the exclamation.

Strategic focus: Completion after effort. 'Наконец' sits before the perfective verb 'закончили', stressing that the task is done after a long process. Mid-sentence placement is neutral and very common.
Strategic focus: Impatient question. In a question 'наконец' adds a tone of impatience, modifying the future verb 'позвонишь'. It conveys that the action has been awaited too long.
Strategic focus: Emphatic relief. The particle 'то' attaches to 'наконец' for extra emotional force, common in speech. It underlines deep satisfaction that the vacation has finally begun.
Strategic focus: Awaited change. 'Наконец' precedes the impersonal verb 'потеплело', marking a welcome turn after a long wait. The phrase 'после долгой зимы' sets up why the relief is felt.
Strategic focus: Belated realization. 'Наконец' modifies the perfective 'понял', signalling that understanding arrived only after delay. Register is neutral and works in both speech and writing.
Strategic focus: End of an unwanted state. Fronted 'наконец' highlights that the rain has stopped at last. It modifies the verb phrase 'перестал идти', expressing relief at the change.
Strategic focus: Resolution at last. 'Наконец' frames 'помирились' as the long-hoped-for outcome of a conflict. The adverb conveys that reconciliation took time to come.
Strategic focus: Awaited arrival. 'Наконец' opens the sentence to stress the relief of the bus finally coming. It modifies 'подъехал', the perfective verb of arrival.
Strategic focus: Hard-won outcome. 'Наконец' modifies 'заснул', showing that sleep came after effort. Mid-sentence position keeps the tone calm and descriptive.
